operating.model: Economic FCFF = economic EBIT after new employee grants and new commercial incentives * (1-normalized operating tax) + D&A - cash capital investment - change in defined operating NWC - change in required operating cash. Existing grant amortization is a GAAP reconciliation only; adding it back cannot raise FCFF above the chosen economic margin.

base_assumption_reasoning.growth: Q1FY2027 formal revenue midpoint1400 implies43%year-over-year growth. Analyst category paths imply34.2%full-year growth and then deceleration. Management optimism about exceedingFY2026growth is not formal annual guidance.
base_assumption_reasoning.margin: FY2026 GAAP operating margin9.97% and Q4 GAAP10.20% anchor the base10.1% economic margin. Future grants and commercial incentives remain explicit costs. Legacy amortization is reversed only inside a neutral reconciliation, never as an extra benefit above that margin.
base_assumption_reasoning.tax: 15%near-term rising to20% is an analyst normalization for global-minimum-tax exposure and Thai incentive expiry. The existingFY2026 tax liability is separately deducted or settled, never ignored.
base_assumption_reasoning.reinvestment: FY2026 cash PPE252.503 plus intangibles1.181; accrued capex298.921; capital payables86.018. The10-K expects higherFY2027 accrued capex, whereas an interview described approximately250cash capex. Base325cash is a conservative analyst choice including July facility purchase and opening-payable settlement; exact timing is uncertain.
base_assumption_reasoning.working_capital: The definedFY2026 operatingNWC proxy is22.3%of sales. Base23%near-term then22%mature funds the ramp. Downside inventory lockup reaches27%despite shrinking sales.
base_assumption_reasoning.terminal: Base nominalUSD growth2.5%, operating margin9.5%, tax20%, and return on beginning capital20%. Final explicit capital is set to next-yearNOPAT/ROIC, ensuring terminal reinvestment exactly finances growth.
base_assumption_reasoning.capacity: Buildings and qualified capacity support the forecast but do not guarantee orders. Near-term9.8bn and possible14bn longer-term revenue capacity are management capacity estimates, not revenue commitments.

uncertainty_policy.why_no_probability: Three judgmental correlated cases; guidance sample does not identify tail probabilities or annual growth distributions. No manufactured confidence intervals.
core_correlations: Lower demand reduces utilization and margin while inventory remains elevated.
Higher data-center growth requires both equipment/capacity capex and additional working capital.
More consigned CPO/NPO material may raise percentage margins while lowering reported revenue; cannot independently increase both without testing absolute profit.
Thai baht labor appreciation can reduce margins even when invoice revenue isUSD.

operating.capital_gate: Source-date per-share allocation is conditionally implementable with explicit claim choices. Current-date output remains blocked until the interim cash-flow and share-count roll-forward is elected and disclosed or reported.

valuation_clock.meaning: An updated forward scenario expressed at the source-dated financial origin. It is not a point-in-time June2026 backtest and is not an assertion of October2026 cash or share value. All FY2027 cash flows, including the July facility purchase, remain in the first forecast year.
valuation_clock.current_date_mode: Disabled unless the user explicitly elects a modeled interim cash-flow/stub roll-forward or later reported data are supplied. Never just change the discount exponent while retaining the full fiscal-year cash flow.

equity_compensation_policy.classification: Analyst recurring economic-cost assumptions, not management guidance or forecasts of grants.
equity_compensation_policy.economic_margin_definition: After ordinary cash operating expenses, new employee-grant compensation equal to0.75%of sales, and an allowance for new commercial equity incentives equal to0.10%of sales. Before noncash amortization of already-existing awards and the March2025 Amazon warrant.
equity_compensation_policy.historical_anchor: FY2026 employee SBC34.630 is0.746%of sales and customer-warrant expense4.800 is0.103%. These observed rates anchor future-cost assumptions; they do not establish an exact future grant schedule.
equity_compensation_policy.legacy_sbc_schedule: Illustrative straight-line runoff using reported weighted-average remaining periods. Actual grant-specific expense may differ. This schedule only reconciles economic EBIT to illustrative GAAP EBIT and back; it cannot affect economic FCFF.
equity_compensation_policy.legacy_warrant_cost_status: Analytical39.3rounded grant-date value minus4.109FY2025 and4.800FY2026 recognized cost. Not a separately disclosed future expense commitment; vesting is conditional. Used only for illustrative GAAP reconciliation, not as an asset or a cash-flow benefit.
equity_compensation_policy.existing_claims: Full outstanding306261zero-strike RSU/PSU awards and maximum381922Amazon warrants in the conservative source-date allocation. Future awards/incentives already charged as economic expenses must not also be added as separate future share claims.

capital_state_policy.definition: Cash-funded operating capital = operating NWC + net PPE/intangibles/goodwill - capital payables + required operating cash.
capital_state_policy.operating_cash: Reserve3%of next-year sales at each fiscal year-end. Every increase is funded through FCFF and invested capital; a release is explicit. Test2–4%jointly with the equity-bridge cash reserve.
capital_state_policy.capital_payables: Opening86.018 is subtracted from funded capital. An illustrative closing balance of75inFY2027 implies accrued additions313.982when cash capex is325. Subsequent balances fade toward0.25%of sales. Cash capex finances settlement; it is not all newly capitalized PPE.
capital_state_policy.asset_rollforward: Accrued capital additions = cash capex + change in capital payables. Net fixed assets increase by accrued additions minus D&A. Funded IC increases by cash capex - D&A + changes in operating NWC and required cash.
capital_state_policy.history_comparison: Historical defined IC excludes cash and does not subtract capital payables. The forecast funded basis is separately labeled; do not compare its ROIC mechanically with the historical proxy.
capital_state_policy.terminal: Terminal ROIC uses cash-funded capital including required operating cash. The final capital target and terminal investment include the cash reserve, avoiding unfunded cash growth.

identity.stock_split_adjustment: No split identified in ten annual filings reviewed; do not apply an inferred split factor.
identity.robinhood_caveat: Public Buy/Trade page verified; this does not establish tradeability in a particular account, jurisdiction or product.

capital.operating_lease_policy: Keep operating rent in EBIT; do not subtract lease liability again under this chosen convention.
capital.existing_tax_claim_policy: Deduct all63.469 of existing tax payable at the financial origin, or model its settlement outside future-income tax, never both. Future operating tax rates apply to future income.
capital.severance_policy: Conservatively deduct34.095 of existing severance obligations. Retain future employee service costs in margins. Do not also deduct settlement of this opening claim in projected FCFF. Discounting/timing can be sensitized.
capital.fixed_asset_payable_policy: Included in future cash-capex schedule, not deducted a second time as debt.
capital.raytek_policy: Separate13.8%non-operating holding. Test32.360 original cost through89.103 carrying value, which uses an observable transaction and illiquidity adjustment. Neither is verified realizable cash. The56.743 gain is not operating EBIT.
capital.repatriation_policy: Potential17.1 withholding tax is not booked. Deduct only when the cash-access assumption requires repatriation; avoid automatic double deduction.
capital.operating_cash_policy: Reserve2–4%nextannualsales, base3%, before treating remainder as excess; analyst estimate, not company-reported cash minimum.

shares.award_policy: Deduct full outstanding RSU/PSU claim value through306261 zero-strike shares in the conservative case. Forecast margins charge new grants, while legacy amortization is only a neutral GAAP reconciliation. Annual EPS weighted shares are not a current share count.

customer_warrant.vesting: Remaining tranches depend on Amazon payments. An acquisition or termination by Amazon for cause accelerates vesting. Maximum shares are not all currently vested.
customer_warrant.valuation_required: Use the coupled share-value/option-value allocation in claim_allocation.py. Equity before existing equity claims equals ordinary and zero-strike-award shares times intrinsic ordinary-share value, plus warrant count times Black-Scholes call value using that same intrinsic share value. Do not use a fixed market price to value options inside an intrinsic valuation.
customer_warrant.double_count_control: Economic forecast margins exclude legacy Amazon-warrant amortization, but retain a separate allowance for new commercial incentives. Existing-grant amortization is subtracted to show illustrative GAAP EBIT and reversed once back to unchanged economic EBIT. Full existing-option allocation therefore does not duplicate an operating expense.

conditional_policy.default_basis: Conservative full-vesting claim assumption, not an assertion of achieved vesting or a probability-weighted expectation.
conditional_policy.volatility_basis: Disclosed grant-date volatility used as an analyst proxy; not observed current implied volatility.
conditional_policy.rate_basis: Linear interpolation of October16 Treasury5year4.89%and7year4.98%par yields; a maturity-matched analytical proxy, not a zero curve or historicalJune26 observation.
conditional_policy.model_limitations: European-option approximation; does not estimate performance-vesting probability or warrant-specific exercise behavior. Full versus vested-only count and35–60%volatility sensitivities bound chosen analytical cases, not all possible outcomes.

source_date_bridge_recipe.formula: Distributable equity before existing equity grants = operatingEV + excess cash + Raytek value - bank debt - existing tax claim - existing severance claim - elected other claims. Allocate this pool with the coupled claim solver.
source_date_bridge_recipe.excess_cash: 875.055 less an operating-cash reserve of2–4%of next-year forecast sales, base3%. Restricted cash0.704 excluded.
source_date_bridge_recipe.subsequent_events: July facility76.9 is in the first full forecast-year capex. The August loan is absent at the June financial origin; its origination adds equal cash and debt and is not a standalone equity loss.
source_date_bridge_recipe.lease_convention: Operating-rent convention: lease costs remain in EBIT and lease debt is not deducted again.
source_date_bridge_recipe.fixed_asset_payables: No separate86.018 debt deduction because the chosen future cash-capex path includes settlement.
source_date_bridge_recipe.other_claim_sensitivity: Other noncurrent liabilities17.826 are not fully decomposed. Use0–17.826 deduction as a visible conditional sensitivity, not an asserted zero. Potential repatriation withholding0–17.1 and Raytek32.360–89.103 are separate switches.
source_date_bridge_recipe.casix_litigation: Unquantified legal tail risk must remain visible. Do not manufacture an expected loss.
source_date_bridge_recipe.operating_cash_funding: The3%reserve is added to operating capital and annual changes are deducted from FCFF; do not treat reserve growth as free. Alternate2–4%ratios require recomputing both forecast and equity bridge.

normalizedCapital.definition: AR + inventory + prepaid expenses + other current assets + separately reported contract assets - trade AP - payroll - accrued expenses - operating other payables - separately reported contract liabilities. Fixed-asset payables excluded from operating NWC; leases treated as operating costs. IC adds net PPE, intangibles and goodwill.
limitations: This is a reproducible operating-capital proxy; other current balances include operating hedges and unspecified assets/liabilities, not every item separately audited. FY2020 investing customer-transfer advance24.310 excluded.
Fixed-asset payables are excluded from NWC; cash-capex forecasts must include their settlement. Do not subtract them again as debt if forecast cash capex funds settlement.
Cash/investments, income taxes, severance and leases are excluded from NWC. Existing severance/tax claims require separate bridge treatment; do not also deduct their cash settlement twice.
R&D is not separately reported; no invented research-asset capitalization. Manufacturing engineering stays in cost of sales.
2017–18 other-payables XBRL includes fixed-asset payables; these are removed. Later comparative balance classifications retained with explicit ASC606 breaks.
